description: Specification content leak: internal document citations (DOC-21), route keys (RT-06, RT-07, RT-08), threat model policies (RLS-01), and test script text were rendered in server-generated UI copy.
root_cause: Hardcoded copy-paste of planning and specification text into user-facing JSX strings during template construction.
remediation: Rewrote all affected UI copy to original, visitor-facing content matching DOC-02 and DOC-17.
Added pre-build blocking audit script (scripts/audit-spec-leak.mjs) executing via package.json prebuild hook.
Configured Webpack IgnorePlugin in next.config.mjs to block .context bundling.
Enacted permanent boundary rule in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.
